title: Open Camping DB fee
description: One line of fees/<place id>.ndjson: what a traveller paid for one night. No names, emails or device IDs, and no key outside this schema.

amount.description: Australian dollars per night, more than 0 and at most 1000, with at most 2 decimal places.

site.description: The kind of site the fee was for.

app.description: Short name of the app that sent the fee.

contributor.description: Opaque id of the account or attested install that sent the fee: ctr_ and 16 hex characters, a salted hash made by the feedback intake, the same id its reviews carry. It never holds a name or email.
